sentences.text: Citalopram -LRB- brand names : Celexa , Cipramil and others -RRB- is an antidepressant drug of the selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor -LRB- SSRI -RRB- class .	antidepressant	antidepressant	drug	Medication	selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor	selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor

It has U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to treat major depression , which it received in 1998 , and is prescribed off-label for other conditions .	Food and Drug Administration	Food and Drug Administration	major depression	Major depressive disorder	off-label	Off-label use

In Australia , the UK , Germany , Portugal , Poland , and most European countries , it is licensed for depressive episodes and panic disorder with or without agoraphobia .	panic disorder	panic disorder	agoraphobia	agoraphobia
In Spain and Denmark it is also used for obsessive-compulsive disorder .	obsessive-compulsive disorder	obsessive-compulsive disorder
